chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Saʿīd ibn Ghazwān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
There shall be nine Imams after al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, the ninth of them being their Qāʾim.

key_terms.قَائِمُهُمْ: Their Qāʾim, the one who rises

ai.seo_question: How many Imams are there after Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, and who is the Qāʾim among them?
ai.summary: This hadith states that after al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام there will be nine Imams. It identifies the ninth among them as the Qāʾim, indicating the awaited Imam within the line of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
